production.direction_en: Inside the wayshrine, the old keeper opens a register of oaths. Brin stands guard at the door.
production.music_direction_en: bgm_ledger_motif (first statement, music-box tempo) under the register; stop on 'An invitation can only be written once.'

commands.speaker: shrine_keeper
commands.text: You saved the woodcutters' children. The road owes you a companion.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: We did not ask for payment.

commands.speaker: shrine_keeper
commands.text: It is not payment. It is an oath. Travelers write here that they will walk for someone else when called.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: And they come? Just like that?

commands.speaker: shrine_keeper
commands.text: The oath binds their road to yours before your paths truly cross. You may meet them later as strangers. The oath remembers even when they do not.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: A promise that remembers people who forget. I should like one of those.

commands.speaker: shrine_keeper
commands.text: Choose with care. An invitation can only be written once.
